# Ajit Khanal

<p class="hero-role">PhD Student in Agricultural and Applied Economics</p>

<p class="hero-copy">I am a PhD student in Agricultural and Applied Economics at Virginia Tech. My research interests are in international trade, agricultural policy, and applied econometrics. I use this site to share my research, teaching, and short explanations of empirical methods.</p>
